name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A checkbox with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states.

meta.when: Choosing any number of options, or agreeing to something that is submitted with a form. For a setting that applies at once use switch; for exactly one of several use radio-group.
meta.example:
<Label><Checkbox defaultChecked /> Email me product news</Label>
<Checkbox checked="indeterminate" aria-label="Select all rows" />
